data.name: QYL0006AnalyzerTitle
data.value: Schema URL stored as a resource attribute

data.name: QYL0006AnalyzerMessageFormat
data.value: Use the ResourceBuilder.AddAttributes schemaUrl parameter; 'telemetry.schema_url' is only an attribute

data.name: QYL0006AnalyzerDescription
data.value: A telemetry.schema_url resource attribute does not set resource schema metadata. Supply a known schema through the SDK schemaUrl parameter; leave unknown schemas unset.

data.name: QYL0401AnalyzerTitle
data.value: GenAI or MCP span missing required attributes

data.name: QYL0401AnalyzerMessageFormat
data.value: GenAI Activity '{0}' is missing required attribute '{1}'

data.name: QYL0401AnalyzerDescription
data.value: GenAI and MCP spans must include the unconditional required attributes for their exact registry-defined discriminator, span kind, and provider refinement. Conditional and recommended attributes are not treated as universally required.

data.name: QYL0402AnalyzerTitle
data.value: Use a registry-defined GenAI token metric

data.name: QYL0402AnalyzerMessageFormat
data.value: GenAI token metric '{0}' is not defined by the pinned registry; its token histograms are '{1}'

data.name: QYL0402AnalyzerDescription
data.value: Token-related GenAI histogram names are checked against the complete metric inventory from the pinned registry, including valid client and server token metrics.

data.name: QYL0403AnalyzerTitle
data.value: GenAI operation name uses non-canonical casing

data.name: QYL0403AnalyzerMessageFormat
data.value: GenAI operation name '{0}' must use registry spelling '{1}'

data.name: QYL0403AnalyzerDescription
data.value: Known GenAI operation names must use the exact casing generated from the pinned registry. Unknown documented system-specific operation names remain allowed.

data.name: QYL0200AnalyzerTitle
data.value: Reserved qyl telemetry name must come from the generated registry catalog

data.name: QYL0200AnalyzerMessageFormat
data.value: Telemetry name '{0}' in a {1} position is not in the generated registry catalog

data.name: QYL0200AnalyzerDescription
data.value: Names in the reserved qyl namespace must use the generated registry vocabulary. Custom application and library scopes, attributes, metrics and events remain valid outside it,. Registry membership is not a universal OpenTelemetry validity check. Use the generated constant for an existing qyl name or add a genuinely qyl-owned definition to the registry.

data.name: QYL0301AnalyzerTitle
data.value: Collector endpoint should use OTLP protocol

data.name: QYL0301AnalyzerMessageFormat
data.value: Collector endpoint '{0}' should use OTLP endpoint (for gRPC typically http(s)://host:4317; for HTTP/protobuf http(s)://host:4318/v1/traces)

data.name: QYL0301AnalyzerDescription
data.value: Collector endpoints should use the OTLP protocol for standardized telemetry export. OTLP provides better performance and broader compatibility than proprietary protocols.

data.name: QYL0202AnalyzerTitle
data.value: High-cardinality tag on metric

data.name: QYL0202AnalyzerMessageFormat
data.value: Tag '{0}' on metric is high-cardinality and may cause memory issues in metrics backends

data.name: QYL0202AnalyzerDescription
data.value: High-cardinality tags like user.id, request.id, or session.id create a unique time series for each distinct value. This can overwhelm metrics backends with memory and storage costs. Consider using these values as span attributes instead, or aggregate them into buckets.

data.name: QYL0600AnalyzerTitle
data.value: Insecure endpoint

data.name: QYL0600AnalyzerMessageFormat
data.value: HTTP endpoint '{0}' should use HTTPS for production security. Consider using https:// instead.

data.name: QYL0600AnalyzerDescription
data.value: HTTP endpoints expose data in transit to interception and man-in-the-middle attacks. Use HTTPS (TLS) for all production endpoints to ensure data confidentiality and integrity. Localhost and 127.0.0.1 are excluded as they are typically used for local development only.

data.name: QYL0012AnalyzerTitle
data.value: Semantic-convention enum value uses non-canonical casing

data.name: QYL0012AnalyzerMessageFormat
data.value: Attribute '{0}' has invalid value '{1}'. Expected: {2}

data.name: QYL0012AnalyzerDescription
data.value: Known enum values must use the exact spelling generated from the complete pinned semantic-convention registry. Unknown extension values remain allowed; primitive value types are handled separately by QYL0013.

data.name: QYL0013AnalyzerTitle
data.value: Incorrect attribute type

data.name: QYL0013AnalyzerMessageFormat
data.value: Attribute '{0}' should be type '{1}' but '{2}' was provided

data.name: QYL0013AnalyzerDescription
data.value: Every exact and template attribute type is generated from the complete pinned semantic-convention registry. Primitive and homogeneous-array mismatches are reported; structured type:any payloads remain governed by their packaged upstream JSON Schemas.

data.name: QYL0601AnalyzerTitle
data.value: Sensitive data in span attribute

data.name: QYL0601AnalyzerMessageFormat
data.value: Attribute '{0}' may contain sensitive data (PII or credentials). Consider redacting or excluding this information.

data.name: QYL0601AnalyzerDescription
data.value: Span attributes containing passwords, secrets, tokens, API keys, or PII (SSN, credit card numbers) can leak sensitive information to telemetry backends. Consider redacting sensitive values or excluding these attributes from telemetry. If the data is intentionally included, suppress this warning with a justification comment.

data.name: QYL0700AnalyzerTitle
data.value: Missing OTLP configuration

data.name: QYL0700AnalyzerMessageFormat
data.value: OTLP exporter configured without explicit endpoint. Set OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT environment variable or pass endpoint in code.

data.name: QYL0700AnalyzerDescription
data.value: When using UseOtlpExporter(), AddOtlpExporter() or WithOtlpExporter() without an explicit endpoint configuration, telemetry will be sent to the default localhost endpoint (localhost:4317 for gRPC, localhost:4318 for HTTP) or fail to export if no collector is running. Configure OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT environment variable or pass the endpoint explicitly in options to ensure reliable telemetry export.

data.name: QYL0701AnalyzerTitle
data.value: Uncompressed OTLP export

data.name: QYL0701AnalyzerMessageFormat
data.value: OTLP exporter using HTTP protocol without compression. Enable gzip compression to reduce bandwidth usage.

data.name: QYL0701AnalyzerDescription
data.value: OTLP does not enable compression by default on either transport: the specification mandates no default, and gRPC is not compressed automatically — both gRPC and HTTP/protobuf send uncompressed payloads unless configured. For exports with large payloads (especially gen_ai.content request and response text), gzip compression significantly reduces bandwidth usage and export latency. Enable it via the OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_COMPRESSION=gzip environment variable, or the exporter's compression option. This rule inspects the HTTP/protobuf configuration path.

data.name: QYL0703AnalyzerTitle
data.value: Consider configuring sampling

data.name: QYL0703AnalyzerMessageFormat
data.value: OpenTelemetry tracing configured without sampling. Consider using ParentBasedSampler or TraceIdRatioBasedSampler to reduce telemetry volume in production.

data.name: QYL0703AnalyzerDescription
data.value: High-volume services can generate excessive telemetry data without sampling configuration. AlwaysOnSampler captures every span, which may overwhelm backends and increase costs. Consider using ParentBasedSampler (respects parent decisions) or TraceIdRatioBasedSampler (probabilistic) for production environments. Tail-based sampling at the collector level is also recommended for capturing important traces like errors.

data.name: QYL0702AnalyzerTitle
data.value: Batch export disabled

data.name: QYL0702AnalyzerMessageFormat
data.value: SimpleSpanProcessor or SimpleActivityExportProcessor exports spans one at a time. Use BatchSpanProcessor or BatchActivityExportProcessor for better performance.

data.name: QYL0702AnalyzerDescription
data.value: SimpleSpanProcessor and SimpleActivityExportProcessor export each span immediately as it completes, which incurs significant overhead. BatchSpanProcessor and BatchActivityExportProcessor collect spans and export them in batches, reducing network overhead and improving application performance. Use batch processors in production environments.

data.name: QYL0304AnalyzerTitle
data.value: EventSource instrumentation is trimmed under Native AOT without EventSourceSupport

data.name: QYL0304AnalyzerMessageFormat
data.value: '{0}' relies on in-process EventSource/EventCounter instrumentation, but PublishAot is set with EventSourceSupport unset — EventSource is trimmed to a no-op under Native AOT, so these events are never emitted at runtime. Set EventSourceSupport=true (accepting the AOT size increase) if you rely on it. OpenTelemetry's OTLP export (ActivitySource + Meter) is unaffected.

data.name: QYL0304AnalyzerDescription
data.value: Under Native AOT with EventSourceSupport unset, the runtime trims EventSource/EventPipe to a no-op: any in-process EventSource, EventListener, or EventCounter — including OpenTelemetry.Instrumentation.EventCounters — silently stops emitting at runtime, with no build error. This rule fires only when such instrumentation is present in the compilation together with PublishAot=true and EventSourceSupport unset, so it does not flag the common OTLP-push app. OpenTelemetry's OTLP export (ActivitySource plus Meter/MeterListener) does not use EventSource and is unaffected; enabling EventSourceSupport increases Native AOT output size, so enable it only when you rely on EventPipe-based instrumentation. The out-of-process case (dotnet-trace/dotnet-counters) is not detectable at compile time and is out of scope.

data.name: QYL0406AnalyzerTitle
data.value: Direct GenAI SDK call bypasses automatic OTel instrumentation

data.name: QYL0406AnalyzerMessageFormat
data.value: Direct {0} SDK call detected. Register the client via AddChatClient(...).AsBuilder().UseFunctionInvocation().UseOpenTelemetry(...).Build() to produce telemetry automatically.

data.name: QYL0406AnalyzerDescription
data.value: Calling a GenAI SDK type directly prevents automatic OpenTelemetry span emission. Wrap the provider client through Microsoft.Extensions.AI.IChatClient so all LLM calls are traced without changes to call sites.

data.name: QYL0305AnalyzerTitle
data.value: Replace legacy SemanticConventions accessor

data.name: QYL0305AnalyzerMessageFormat
data.value: '{0}' is a legacy OpenTelemetry semantic convention accessor. Use the grouped '{1}' constant instead.

data.name: QYL0305AnalyzerDescription
data.value: The aggregated SemanticConventions / TraceSemanticConventions / ResourceSemanticConventions static classes are deprecated in favour of per-domain grouped attribute classes (HttpAttributes, ServerAttributes, DbAttributes, etc.). Per-domain grouping mirrors the upstream OpenTelemetry semantic conventions layout and produces smaller, more navigable diffs on convention upgrades.

data.name: QYL0110AnalyzerTitle
data.value: A catch that throws inside a span starter's scope must call RecordFailure

data.name: QYL0110AnalyzerMessageFormat
data.value: This catch throws inside the scope of '{0}' without RecordFailure; the span ends without its failure

data.name: QYL0110AnalyzerDescription
data.value: A span whose operation fails needs status Error with a description, error.type and the exception event, or the collector records a success with an empty failure message. Call span.RecordFailure(exception) in every catch that throws inside the scope of a Qyl.Spans or Qyl.IncubatingSpans starter.

data.name: QYL0112AnalyzerTitle
data.value: Span work names and business keys are compile-time constants

data.name: QYL0112AnalyzerMessageFormat
data.value: The {0} '{1}' is not a compile-time constant

data.name: QYL0112AnalyzerDescription
data.value: A Spans.Work name identifies an operation and must stay low-cardinality. Use a constant and put varying values into native Activity.SetTag attributes.

data.name: QYL0120AnalyzerTitle
data.value: No OpenTelemetry.Instrumentation.* package next to AddQyl

data.name: QYL0120AnalyzerMessageFormat
data.value: '{0}' from {1} records spans AddQyl already records; remove it

data.name: QYL0120AnalyzerDescription
data.value: AddQyl subscribes the HTTP server, HttpClient, Npgsql, Kafka and GenAI spans itself. A TracerProviderBuilder extension from an OpenTelemetry.Instrumentation.* assembly records the same operations a second time.

data.name: QYL0121AnalyzerTitle
data.value: Custom value equals a registry member

data.name: QYL0121AnalyzerMessageFormat
data.value: '{0}' is {1}; use the member instead of Custom

data.name: QYL0121AnalyzerDescription
data.value: Custom is the escape hatch for a value the registry does not list. A value a member already carries hides the member from readers and refactoring tools.

data.name: QYL0122AnalyzerTitle
data.value: No span starter inside an AIFunction

data.name: QYL0122AnalyzerMessageFormat
data.value: '{0}' starts a span inside a delegate passed to AIFunctionFactory.Create, whose execute_tool span FunctionInvokingChatClient already records

data.name: QYL0122AnalyzerDescription
data.value: FunctionInvokingChatClient records the execute_tool span of every AIFunction it invokes, and the registry says not to record two spans for one tool call. Inside the function, set application attributes on Activity.Current with SetTag instead.
